primary_question: Does the funding + price-dislocation feature set improve out-of-sample forecasts of a SIGNED-JUMP / SEMIVARIANCE-ASYMMETRY tail event beyond an RV-only baseline on the broad ironflow_bulk panel, clearing a frozen 2% materiality floor, WHEN ALL FCLR-POOLED-AUDIT-001 leakage remediations are applied simultaneously (48h purge+embargo, NON-overlapping forward-outcome windows, mark/index tolerance filter, delisting-aware per-coin identity, per-coin cluster bootstrap, Holm across the declared family)?

design.forecast_origin: per-coin NON-OVERLAPPING origins spaced >= 24h (close of hour t)
design.target: jump event y_t = 1 if J_{t+1..t+24} > q_t
design.jump_definition: J = sign(RS+ - RS-) * (RV - BV); RV = sum of squared 1h log returns over next 24h; BV = bipower variation; RS+/RS- = realized semivariance of positive/negative returns
design.quantile_q_t: expanding, TRAIN-ONLY per-coin high quantile (0.95) of trailing signed-jump magnitude |J|, shifted by 1 (no future information)
design.candidate: RV + signed funding_rate + abs(funding_rate) + premium + mark/EMA24 distance

materiality_definition: candidate relative Brier (or log-loss) improvement over the RV-only baseline must exceed 0.02 (2%); verdict is symmetric PROMOTED / NOT_SUPPORTED; a null that survives the remediations is a valid, publishable negative result

verdict_rule.PROMOTED: materiality_met is True AND candidate beats baseline on Brier (Holm-adjusted)
verdict_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: materiality floor not met (valid, publishable negative result; closes the jump arm for good)

universe: coins present in candles_1h AND funding AND open_interest (intersection), delisting-aware, with sufficient trailing history for train-only quantile and mark/index tolerance
frozen_inputs_note: ironflow_bulk 18 monthly parquet per dataset; sha256-asserted; read-only; bounds 2025-05 .. 2026-10
distinct_from_prior: Materially different robustness RE-CONFIRMATION of the closed FCLR-VOL-JUMP-01 null (adds non-overlapping forward windows, mark/index tolerance filter, delisting-aware identity); NOT a relabel or re-run of jump01, mean-QLIKE, correction-time, or total-variance tail-exceedance endpoints.
